sentiment.title: Sentiment
sentiment.why_it_matters: Positioning extremes are contrarian indicators; crowded longs in risk assets increase fragility.

sections.question: Are institutional positioning and broad sentiment aligned or diverging?
sections.answer: Data not yet active for this section.
sections.why: When asset managers are crowded long and leveraged money is not yet following, drawdowns tend to be sharper.
sections.risk: Asset manager crowding near multi-year highs reduces the available buyer base for any sustained rally.
sections.support: Leveraged money neutrality limits the forced-selling cascade risk that accompanies full two-sided crowding.
sections.caveat: NAAIM and AAII survey data are candidate-only sources; only CFTC positioning is active.
